jobs.title: Environmental Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description

CDMS, founded in 1988, provides comprehensive regulatory compliance services focused on EPA and Cal-OSHA requirements. The company supports California organizations in maintaining compliance with environmental and safety regulations at local, state, and federal levels. CDMS works across industries to help clients navigate complex regulatory frameworks and minimize risk. The team emphasizes practical, cost-effective solutions and ongoing guidance to ensure sustained compliance and safe operations. CDMS offers a professional environment for specialists interested in regulatory work and environmental protection.

Role Description

The Environmental Specialist is a full-time, remote role responsible for supporting clients with environmental health and safety (EHS) and regulatory compliance. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing and interpreting environmental regulations, assisting with compliance assessments, and preparing documentation, reports, and guidance materials for clients. The role involves supporting the development and implementation of environmental policies and programs, tracking regulatory changes, and helping clients respond to inspections or audits. The Environmental Specialist will collaborate with internal team members and client stakeholders through virtual meetings, providing clear communication and technical support. This role requires strong attention to detail, analytical skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a remote work setting.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess skills in Environment Health and Safety (EHS) and Environmental Science.
Candidates should possess skills in Environmental Compliance and Environmental Policy.
Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication with clients and team members.
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Occupational Health and Safety, or a related field.
Experience with EPA and Cal-OSHA regulations or similar regulatory frameworks is beneficial.
Ability to analyze complex regulatory information and translate it into practical guidance for clients.
Strong organizational and time-management skills, with experience working independently in a remote setting.
Proficiency with standard office software and online collaboration tools.
Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency is an advantage.

Why CDMS?

Advance your environmental career with technical and project management growth
Hybrid work arrangement available after onboarding
Supportive, innovative team culture
Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, 401K (Roth and Non-Roth options) with generous match, HSA
Directly impact California companies and employee safety
Professional development and continued education support

Commitment to Diversity

CDMS is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace.
Job Type: Full-time

Benefits:

401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Health Savings Account
Flexible Spending Account & Dependent Care
Paid time off
Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Environmental Health Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Responsibilities
:
Adhere to all SOPs & safety policies & procedures
Act as SME regarding EH&S company policies & practices – help develop & update P&Ps
Address hazards and engage in appropriate corrective actions
Support the maintenance of operating permits, licenses, registrations & reports as required by state & federal regulatory bodies – ensure 100% compliance
Support the removal of hazardous waste – including the storage & disposal
Perform daily checks and inspections
Support & promote a culture of safety
Support safety audits
Respond to all alarms/emergencies – on-call responder for calls
Stay up to date with all EH&S training
Escort contractors and vendors while onsite
Conduct routine safety inspections
Support incident investigations – perform root cause analysis & prepare detailed reports
Support the development & delivery of EH&S employee training programs
Participate in emergency response planning & drills
Partner with cross-functional teams to implement EH&S initiatives
Maintain records & documentation to ensure accuracy
Evaluate EH&S metrics & prepare reports for management as needed
Other duties as assigned

Job Requirements
:
Degree in EH&S or similar field preferred
2+ years of industry EH&S experience
Knowledge of federal, state & local laws & regulations
Good understanding of EH&S best practices
Experience with investigations & root cause analysis
Strong verbal & written communication skills
DoT HazMat Transportation Cert. preferred (49 CFR 172.704)
Knowledge of cGMP preferred
